name: Conservative: Grass cover crop – Corn – Wheat – Soybean
description: Keeps the base of the current rotation with minimal changes (grass cover crop in the winter of year 1).
management: terminate the cover crop in August so it does not use the fallow's water

name: Recommended mix: Wheat/second-crop soybean – vetch – corn
description: A double crop for income and a legume before corn to add nitrogen.
rule_ids: seleccion:mejor de 3 variantes mixtas con tus prioridades
management: terminate the cover crop in time (August-September) so the soil profile recharges before the summer crop
check soil-profile water at wheat planting: the double crop only pays off if water is stored

name: Cover crop – soybean – vetch – corn
description: It covers the soil in both winters: the grass before soybean (stops erosion) and the legume before corn (adds nitrogen).
management: terminate the cover crop in time (August-September) so the soil profile recharges before the summer crop
obtain cover-crop seed and budget for planting and termination costs

name: Corn – peanut – wheat/second-crop soybean
description: With irrigation, it prioritizes the crops with the highest relative income and includes a wheat/soybean double crop.
management: secure a sales contract for the peanut
plant the second-crop soybean as soon as the wheat is harvested

name: Soybean – wheat – vetch – sunflower – corn
description: Five crops from three families, alternating summer and winter; it keeps sunflower 4 years apart and precedes corn with a deep-rooted crop.
management: terminate the cover crop in time (August-September) so the soil profile recharges before the summer crop

name: Sorghum – wheat with supplemental irrigation
description: With irrigation, it replaces corn with sorghum (lower demand) and uses a winter cereal that consumes water when ET0 is lowest, to cut irrigation volume.
management: adjust the irrigation depth to sorghum, which needs less water than corn
